path.id: The busiest emergency hot spots are in the 4th Battalion
Emergency and service calls per hexagon, Feb 1 â€“ Sep 16, 2026. Four of the five busiest hexagons are in the 4th Battalion, and the busiest 10% of hexagons hold 27% of calls.

Sources: NERIS Public incidents (Jersey City Fire Department). Emergency = every incident not coded non-emergency, including public-service calls such as citizen assists and alarm activations; 95 located outside the city are excluded. Battalion lines: data.jerseycitynj.gov.
